Displacement test for GBMN

Source: R/disp_gbmn.R
disp_gbmn.Rd

The displacement (D) quantifies the extent to which the parameters of current GBMN must change in order to maximally align with the new data. The learning rate is set sufficiently high so the centrality of the generalized posterior is shifted fully dominated by the data. In comparison, the model predictions prior to the update 'behave' as not having learned from the new data. The displacement measures how much information the data provides to shift the expected value relative to the prediction and spread of the current GBMN. A value close to 0 indicates the data provides relatively limited information that would result in the displacement of the expected value.

Usage

disp_gbmn(object, new_data, nsim = 3000, level = 0.9, seed = 123)

Arguments

object

A foundational or updated GBMN.

new_data

New dataset with all root nodes and least one child node present.

nsim

Number of simulations used to construct the intervals.

level

Credibility level (default level = 0.9).

seed

Seed value 123.
